findings.text: the else branch reports "the override did not take effect" when an arm is merely absent, because _load_arm:619 returns an exception stub whose hook_names list is empty and the verdict keys on hook_names alone; bisect-run1-chdir-defect.log shows both classes printing that finding at exit 0 with traced_residual=None, and the branch additionally reports profile_support_invariant=true and terminal_residual_differ=false over arms that never ran, so a receipt that measures nothing reads as a receipt that refutes the hook.

the mixed class's generated finding reads "the anchor partition is the carrier: holding the three anchors constant changes the terminal state" for a gap at the round-off floor (2.2041968427410595e-16 against 3.0996518101046146e-16, both converged), which alone contradicts the node's own exoneration and needs the prose in receipt.html:61-66 to be read correctly.
the instrument table states the slowest compile was "4m18s" while bisect.log's slowest slow-compile alarm is 4m30.589312894s, so the record understates the worst compile it reports on.

justifications.durability: no test imports or pins the driver's receipt join or its missing-arm branch (only tests/test_bank_drift_paired_probe.py references bank_drift at all, importing benchmarks.bank_drift_paired_probe), while the sibling driver's join is pinned by a committed test in the same campaign, so the campaign precedent for a pinning test is unmet here.
justifications.evidence: every verdict field of receipt-21978-35-anchor-bisect.json is exactly reproducible from the four committed arm JSONs and the committed bank reference (recomputed in review, all equal), the job record matches sacct 1273425 (gres/gpu=1, 8 cores, 128G, 52m51s, COMPLETED, one allocation not an array), and the traced arm bit-matches the committed bank operands (structure 0fe0dcdf920a9b66, values 35c0be67ae2abdd8, support 5683f88ca97c076e); the three findings sit in the receipt's interpretation layer against numbers that all verify.
justifications.fit: the driver compiles under the project 3.14 interpreter, ruff passes path-scoped, its helpers (_digest, _partition_report, _hollow_after) mirror benchmarks/bank_drift_paired_probe.py:147-233, and no plan, stage or ticket identifier appears in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/bank_drift_anchor_bisect.py:385-435 solves 21978/35 pure and mixed under both anchor treatments in one job, and receipt-21978-35-anchor-bisect.json records the pure arms landing on the identical 2.4506488565449e-03 under active_set_cycle_detected with the cause placed downstream of the hook.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --name-only over 78b8d9a7, b3c5c2f8 and 4bb66038 lists only the declared write paths, git diff 54b554ce..HEAD is empty for nova/, tests/, scripts/ and AGENTS.md, and the plan edit is additive (16 insertions, 0 deletions).
